authorization.summary: Continue adding and maintaining the DSH Store knowledge-base content.

sources: current repository source and verification documentation
merged GitHub Catalog and public-surface readback when an incident is published
prohibitedClaims: static checks prove a real Profile install or runtime
unknown evidence is safe or compatible
users should edit Profile files or bypass the official DSH CLI
contentPolicy.privacy: Never publish credentials, complete Profiles, environment variables, private paths, or user content.

gates: wiki navigation and the incident page are covered by a deterministic source test
GitHub Wiki contains the committed source pages after the main branch merge

rollback.repository: revert the exact squash merge through a new pull request
rollback.wiki: restore the affected Markdown page from the merged docs/wiki source and commit it to the Wiki repository

nonGoals: do not modify Catalog entries, candidate records, DSH core, or @deepseek-ai packages
do not install, update, restart, or edit a real DSH Profile
do not claim real runtime or independent security-audit evidence without it
